### 1. This week's analysis

*What is a VCF?*

A Variant Call Format (VCF) file is a standardized, tab-delimited text file used in bioinformatics to store gene sequence and DNA variations (such as single nucleotide polymorphisms \[SNPs\], insertions, deletions, and structural variants).

It is typically the end product of a next-generation sequencing (NGS) and variant-calling pipeline, where an individual's sequenced DNA is aligned against a reference genome to pinpoint differences.

```{r}

              "data/week06/eelgrass-demo.vcf")

              "data/week06/popmap.tsv")
```
